title: Purpose that answers the gift of birth
subtitle: For the life that must not sleep through its chance
description: These readings follow the rare human chance into Naam, sangat, service, and the urgency of meeting the Lord while there is still time.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Human birth is a door opened for meeting the Lord of the Universe.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Let the day be shaped by the meeting it was given for.

evidence.coreClaim: This journey treats purpose as a response to the rare chance of embodied life.
evidence.turn: The ordinary day becomes weighty when it is aimed toward meeting Gobind.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before the day scatters, give one decision to Naam, sangat, or seva.
